[h1]Update 1.1[/h1]

[*] [b]Eitr Enhancer[/b] changed from [b]common [/b]to [b]uncommon[/b].

notes.title: Gorgeous Norse mythology city builder Roots of Yggdrasil is out now
notes.content:
Post-apocalyptic settings are rarely this beautiful, but roguelike city builder Roots of Yggdrasil is a different breed. Inspired by Norse mythology and set in the wake of Ragnarok, it's left to your tribe to explore the fractured World Tree. Blending Civilization style hex-grid city building and the roguelike deckbuilding of Slay the Spire, this strategy game is one of the prettiest you'll see all year, and you can grab it at a special discount right now as it leaves Steam Early Access.

notes.title: Update 1.0 : Valkyrie's Lament
notes.content:
[h1]Introduction[/h1]
Welcome to [b]Roots of Yggdrasil 1.0[/b]!

This update contains new characters, buildings and over 100+ Changes and improvements! Over the course of Early Access, we've used your feedback to shape the game. We've added and reworked a lot of systems, but until now, most of the quests, characters and collection was left incomplete. This changes now as we tie up those loose ends today! We are very excited to bring you this massive update. Hope you enjoy it 🤗 

[previewyoutube=y96K5yRfNWM;full][/previewyoutube]

Before we go in-depth, here's is a quick recap of some of the biggest features added in this update.
[list]
[*] New Scion : The Valkyrie
[*] New Housing : Hall Houses
[*] New Adventures & Map events
[*] New Artifacts & Buildings
[*] A Conclusion to all the Quests!
[*] ...And much more!
[/list]

[h1]New Playable Scion : The Valkyrie[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/88c6c16d469ed8957305742a1a7c8ae0fc88cb20.png[/img]
Eir, our new Playable scion, is centered on Threats. It’s all about taking risks, creating danger in order to exploit it. Let’s look at her starting passives :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/db0564176f0df436a1df7eba92989828d549c921.png[/img]

War Cry gives might income per turn every time a Threat spawns. This helps dealing with most of them, which will trigger its second passive, gaining population when you spend might. With this, you can now see why spawning threats is interesting for Eir. This is why her active ability, Cursed Valkyrie, simply spawns a Threat on the map. But be careful, it could be a draugr camp, a storm or even a fire!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/68c7f2eb12332f24ddd3be3ed39a46c99ee987de.gif[/img]

[h1]New Housing : Halls [/h1]
New Housing Type available : Great Halls and Hall Houses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/9ce9e5d75852aeb7d05e4eea405a4ea91c0feeca.png[/img]

Great halls are expansive buildings that can be upgraded when placing housing near them. Hall houses are cheap, but do not give anything by themselves. Place them near Great Halls to obtain population. Each upgrade of the Great Hall gives an income of a different resource, so place your housing carefully!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/31e880831786d28980e2350e2cce779b9660632b.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/181f3c3685ac0849a27ac3e0216fa724ec5a576e.png[/img]
[h1]Buildings 🏭[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/c739c03176722aa089450b6075417770ca8d71ae.png[/img]
[i][b]Developer Notes: [/b] With this update we're bringing many more deckbuilding options. Raiding camp allows you to keep threats around for a bonus if you can manage them. Lodging upgrade opens all kinds of possibilities with each housing type. Cart maker brings a new mechanic to the game by creating a zone around it that will allow you to draw cards when building in it.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/0a6fe90c94f1c9ad846de9c88d9cc69113c25c9c.png[/img]
[i][b]Developer Notes: [/b]We also added more options to play with Eitr with the Eitr Transformer and Enhancers. This new guild will also work well with Eir's new powers focused on Threats. [/i]

[h1]Artifacts 💍[/h1]
You'll find new artifacts both in the default pool and some to unlock in the Greenhouse this patch. Take a look at some of them : 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/9bdc859203450efd66e8b6eeeecded7839d12e30.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/b4c1b9714223aa753ae5582256fe8307ada85775.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/366e3c780b0c255283aa2ff687098a7bfc442dba.png[/img]

[i][b]Developer Notes: [/b] This time again, our goal with artifacts is to allow new playstyles. Use [b]Living Brick[/b] to reduce the cost of your buildings and draft more. Skip those drafts to upgrade your deck using [b]Verdant Hoe[/b] or draft ephemeral cards to benefit from the bonus of [b]Mead of Poetry[/b] when they leave your deck. [/i]

There's some other artifacts as well, but we'll let you discover them yourselves!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/669d392ab45f347c7d7c39770239b840d5a69a9a.png[/img]

[h1]Events & Adventures[/h1]
[list][*] New Warden : Gerda
    [list]
    [*] The Last Jotun joins the adventure! Explore Asgard to meet our new warden. Gerda has her own story and events for you to discover![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/043e5df60e20a9bdd1cde90c947e60c78548889c.png[/img][/list]
[*] 3 New Adventures
    [list]
    [*] [b]Runic Forge[/b] : Transform your resources from a type to another![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/d0ab0ae3fe18ed68f2d82c1a44dc7c416ad09d16.png[/img]
    [*] [b]Runic Stone[/b] : Add a keyword to a card.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/7a5075b0db753b9b9c1df607def06891973eff74.png[/img]
    [*] [b]Runic Altar[/b] : Gain a Brittle Action card.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/6c5a37e2e4f5b40061621f023926b08075551360.png[/img][/list]
[*] Improved Wardens :
    [list]
    [*] When reaching 2 Kinships with [b]Sibyl, Njord, Vidarr[/b] and [b]Gerda[/b], they will now appear in special events during Travel.
    [*]  When maxing Kinships with [b]Sibyl, Njord, Vidarr[/b] and [b]Gerda[/b], they will unlock a Holt building which improve their powers.[/list]
[*] Added 5 new random Timeline Events to more than double the variety of events.
[*] Added new [b]negative [/b]keywords that can be added to cards :
     [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/b85cec088e7d418df4483c4055bab1964af0ce96.png[/img]
[i][b]Developer Notes: [/b] Card keywords are something we've been wanting to add for a while. This time however, we're adding [b]negative[/b] keywords! Some trials and events will add them to cards in your deck, forcing you to think carefully about deckbuilding and the order of played cards![/i]
[/list]


[h1]Trials[/h1]
[list]
[*] Trials now apply a multiplier on total meta resources obtained in loop. Be daring, receive more loot! 
[*] Added New Trials[list]
 [*] Weakened [b]1/2/3[/b] : Increase Housing Building cost by [b]2/4/6[/b] supplies.
 [*] Cursed : Add negative keywords to cards[list]
  [*] Cursed 1 : Add [b]Burden[/b] to a card.
  [*] Cursed 2 : Add [b]Frail[/b] to a card.
  [*] Cursed 3 : Add [b]Haunted[/b] to a card.[/list][*] Added New Difficulty Levels[list]
   [*] Increased level cap of scion and housing from [b]5[/b] to [b]10[/b].
   [*] Increased amount of active trials needed to level changed from [b]1/2/3/4/5[/b] to [b]1/3/5/7/10/13/16/20/25/30[/b][/list][*] Leveling Scions and Housing now gives matter and blueprints rewards.
 [*] Improved feedback on the levels of Scion and Housing in Expedition Screen. You can now see your current trial level, active trials, your supply multiplier and  the requirements to level up for scions and housing.[/list]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/b15355cf05d245530ed5f4e88e2ca76760b30a0b.png[/img]
[h1]Balance 📝[/h1]
[h2]Trials🌞[/h2][list]
[*] Maxing a Trial now gives an extra trial point.
[*] [b]Lethargy[/b] has a new level : Population required to draft new cards increased from [b]1/2[/b] to [b]1/2/3[/b].
[*] [b]Bad Draugr[/b] has a new level : Draugr's range increased from [b]50%/150%[/b] to [b]50%/100%/150%[/b].
[*][b]Hard To Crack[/b] has two new levels : Sapling requirements increased from [b]25%/50%[/b] to [b]25%/50%/75%/100%[/b].
[/list]
[h2]Artifacts & Powers🔨[/h2][list]

notes.title: 1.0 Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[h1]🚀The 1.0 Release Date 🚀[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/341a1b4a584cdd363ff44c02422b30141ca19a88.png[/img]
[h1][b] What's in it? [/b][/h1]
It's official, Roots of Yggdrasil releases in 1.0 Soon! But what's in this new update?
We had planned another patch before releasing 1.0, but as we worked on it, we realized bundling all the changes together made way more sense. That means the next patch is going to be BIG. Let's take a a quick look at some of the changes.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/181f3c3685ac0849a27ac3e0216fa724ec5a576e.png[/img]
[h2]New Events[/h2]
We are adding more variety in the events you'll encounter in each biome. You'll meet new characters that offer strong boons to help you overcome the challenging trials ahead.

[b]Sneak Peek:[/b] You'll sometimes find [b]Runic Stones[/b], which can be used to add keywords on a card in your deck. These allow you to customize your deck further and create stronger synergies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/cc6aede8328e4fe1949772308fc5bfdb049bab99.gif[/img]

[h2]New Cards & Artifacts[/h2]
We've added new cards to play with too! This time, we're also focusing on opening new build opportunities with new mechanics. We won't spoil too much now since there's a many some new mechanics that are introduced. 

[b]Sneak Peek:[/b] Here's a new common, uncommon and rare building cards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/7f000f0d114ad99ad6cc0d2964711803d5d6aeb4.png[/img]

[h2]New Scion and Housing[/h2]
This patch will contain our fourth playable scion and housing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/a15bda11d2cb1d10c9cae5ce6c7038f4667ae14f.png[/img]
We won't talk about them yet, but like other scions, this new character comes with a full story and quest! We'll let you discover how to unlock them!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/b15355cf05d245530ed5f4e88e2ca76760b30a0b.png[/img]
[h2]Character's Quests and Storylines[/h2]
We've added the end of every character quest in the game, including a unique reward for each of them. You'll want to make some place in your Holt to enjoy some of the new powers!

[h2]Reworked Expedition Screen[/h2]
We've made many improvements to the UI when preparing for an expedition. You'll now find a much clearer explanation of the strengths of each Scion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/469fed0b365df952e3c471f6e24db5a0561ecbc5.gif[/img]

[h2]Reworked Trials[/h2]
When choosing Trials, you'll have an easy way to see if your Scion or housing will level up if you succeed. In addition, your trial level now adds a multiplier on matter acquired during loops!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/36802df8c64b8e275d66ddbe893bea66f390dc58.gif[/img]


[h2]Rebalancing the Holt[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/69c5024841511d09a89bf44ef1af502f21d55e84.png[/img]
We're using 1.0 to rebalance the Holt buildings. Overall, we felt the progression was a bit too slow and also too restrictive. Expect less requirements on Holt buildings in the future and more ways to obtain amenity tags. We also don't plan to wipe anything, so if a building you placed gets rebalanced, you'll be able to simply remove it and replace it elsewhere if you prefer!


[h1]Price Change[/h1]
Please note, the game's price will increase slightly as we officially leave early access. There will be a launch discount, but keep this in mind as we head into launch.

A BIG thank you to all of our community and our development team! We're excited to share the full version of [i][b]Roots of Yggdrasil [/b][/i] with you. If you haven't done so already, please consider leaving a review as it really helps us in terms of discoverability at launch. As always, if you have any questions or comments, please leave them below or join our Discord.

[url=https://discord.gg/N2wRSNFbPG][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/250ec921b6f9622bd6edb8e42ddd01edce16367a.png[/img][/url]

We're incredibly excited for Roots of Yggdrasil to fully release. We couldn't have made it here without your valuable feedback, support and validation all throughout the Early Access period. Thanks for being here with us and looking forward to what the future holds.

- The Manavoid Team

notes.title: Update 4 : Home Sweet Holt 🚧
notes.content:
[h1]Introduction[/h1]
This update brings big changes to meta progression. Here's an overview of the content : 
[list]
[*] Holt Overhaul
[*] Over [b]50[/b] New Holt Buildings
[*] [b]4[/b] New Artifacts
[*] [b]5[/b] New Building Cards
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/fa69e90458fbacf046fac7ba1e7d9e0b28e840ee.png[/img]


[h1]Holt Refactor[/h1]
Ratatoskr is in a renovating mood! The first thing you notice when landing at the new Holt is that your precious buildings have been dismantled. But fear not! Invested resources have been refunded!

Our goal with this update was to redesign the meta systems of the Holt in order to create a strong foundation for long term progression. It also allowed to rebalance the holt buildings while adding a LOT of variety in the effects. This should allow for more build expression in the builds you create.

[h2]The Workshop🃏[/h2]
Holt buildings are now acquired different building packs in the Workshop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/b4767b4711c3dc5324a3b336a9a75e6c750cf34a.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Building Packs[/b] allow you to spend [b]blueprints[/b] to unlock new holt buildings. These buildings come in four different rarities. Spend more blueprints on the premium pack for a bigger chance of rare buildings!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/df07499ba6610a93cb779ea00b0c64232a97da86.gif[/img]
[*][b] Cosmetic Pack[/b] allow you to obtain resources and cosmetic resources to place in the Holt. The perfect way to customize your holt!
[*] [b]Housing pack[/b] cost [b]matter[/b] and allow you to increase your housing cap. Each building with a positive effect will require a nearby housing so increasing your housing cap is a good indicator of your Holt's progression!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/285c6550d8ad67b48b98e01a1dc13348699f15cc.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Placement Mode 🔨[/h2]
[list]
[*] Holt buildings are now placed through a shiny new placement mode rather than through the workshop.
[*] Holt Buildings available are displayed as a hand of cards like they are in a loop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/ebfeead462f44a03b99752c9168f4013848cb241.gif[/img]
[*] Holt buildings can now be removed anytime through the Dismantle card available in the placement mode, as long as that building isn’t currently being exploited. Dismantling a building refunds its full cost in materials to your inventory and returns its card to your hand, allowing you to place it elsewhere.
[*] The Buildings tab in the Workshop now lists all Holt buildings available in the game. Get out there and collect them all!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/b749709e9abaaeeb700162e85257b26f56152b42.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Improvements ✨[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Holt received a visual upgrade, including lighting and VFX improvements!
[*] The renovations have left a big mess in the Holt! Use Matter to clear a path and unlock new building zones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/0da300b7a993383c0fc227d9680288c2faf39eb1.gif[/img]
[*] Running out of building space? The Holt can be expanded further in the Greenhouse!
[*] The main menu has been reworked!
[/list]

[h2]New Cards[/h2]
[h3]Refiners🏭[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/d0d519a6e38fb9393aa2792dbf696be05af89e7f.png[/img]

[i][b]Developer Notes: [/b] Refiners are one of the hardest requirement to fulfill on Saplings. With these, we hope to give more options and flexibility to complete those objectives.[/i]

[h3]Might 🔪[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/95d5ae06534fb594817466db12a84ff313906e23.png[/img]

[i][b]Developer Notes: [/b] While there's already a few reliable options to generate might, we think adding more of them will allow you to create builds where the cards that generate might combo with other effects in your builds.[/i]

[h3]Amenity🍺[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/4d69ee065e23e9169025c05558c798d02d1348f0.png[/img]

[i][b]Developer Notes: [/b] This one should give a little more options for cards with exhaust. It also gives another way to spend Eitr if you're looking in creating combos with exhaust cards.[/i]

[h2]Artifacts 💍[/h2]
This update we bring you a set of artifacts that plays around time. Take a look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/4764e585b6db68504dc41466ec20f2b79d718137.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/507b296b163c3d67107e595c893819a99200d14a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/851a9d1732ec4fdc45e07c4770b965bcaa8586d3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/4ad5b706c2ccf8de5c01ddc2c0c34be583f6c176.png[/img]

[i][b]Developer Notes: [/b] With these artifacts, we want to give more possibilities to play with time. The Mane artifacts allow you to sacrifice turns for improved income, while the others capitalize on spending more time at night.[/i]

[h2]Balance 📝[/h2]
[list]
[*] “Fire” Threat’s amount of turns before destroying buildings has been increased [b](3 → 4)[/b]
[*] Existing Holt buildings have had their effects and requirements rebalanced.
[*] Increases the amount of [b]Matter[/b] obtained at the end of an island : 
    [list]
    [*] For Fully explored maps : [b]0 → 10[/b]
    [*] For Threats removed : [b]1 → 2[/b]
    [*] For Caves and Shipwrecks completed : [b]0 → 2[/b]
    [/list]
[*] Increased the amount of [b]Blueprints[/b] obtained at the end of an island. The first island gives 1 and that value increase for each subsequent upgrade.
[*] Improved Procedural generation when calculating objectives to put on map. Short term, this should make it so less similar objectives appear on the map. Long term, this will allow us to diversify the kinds of adventures that happen in a single loop.
[*] Rebalanced most existing effects of Holt Buildings.
[*] Keywords on Action cards have been standardized so cards with [b]Brittle [/b]always have [b]Retain[/b].
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes 🐛[/h2][list]
[*] Fixed Unlock conditions for many character’s Kinships.
[*] Fixed Unlock conditions for many Milestones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/7ee4ff02a1d8d85d69ea759b5a54b1c0dcde71c1.gif[/img]
[*] Fixed Issues with Azerty layout.
[*] Fixed mouse being confined in windowed mode.
[*] Fixed calculation of some artifacts being calculated twice.
[*] Fixed warehouse calculating initial draw for its effect.
[*] Fixed issues with selection of cards when using shortcuts.
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life 😇[/h2][list]
[*] Improved sorting of cards in hands Compendium and hands.
[*] Improved tracking of milestones.
[*] Added Many Milestones for Kinships of Scions and Wardens to help tracking of objectives.
[*] Main menu was reworked and cleaned!
[*] Improved card draw/discard animations.
[*] The list of Holt effects is now much clearer than before!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/218b95344e46010ac5217abd1bdf094357d1cf94.png[/img]
[/list]


[h2]It's LIVE! 🔥[/h2]
Did we mention the game is 25% off to celebrate the release of the Update? 
Consider sharing it with your friends before the game's priced is increased once the full release of 1.0!

We're excited to know what you think of the new Holt system! Hop on Discord or the Steam forums to share your Holt and your feedback about the new system. See you soon for another news!

notes.title: Update 3 : Playing with Fire 🔥
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/57ab90a675aecf2e485745dad41f1f12a04d3afc.png[/img]
[h2]Introduction[/h2]
In this new update, we're focusing on adding more variety to the challenges that you're going to encounter. In addition, we've added a selection of new buildings and artifacts that will allow you to support a bigger variety of builds, especially when it comes to harvesting and creating resources!

[h2]New Threat : Fires![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/d8a9a2c6c999ba4dafe42f4aa33bbbf29e58f4f8.gif[/img]

Draugr can now raid your camp, setting fire to some buildings. Each turn, the fire will spread. After 3 turns, buildings on fire will be destroyed. You can stop the fires by building a Might building adjacent to it. Before you decide to ignore the fire spreading, make sure [i]Skidbladnir[/i] is safe!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/a9ffa0e373b9ffa105e37769bf99b05eefa0fe1e.gif[/img]

[h2]New Cards[/h2]
[h3]Resource Creation[/h3]
We're empowring a new playstyle based on resource exploitation with this update. Your first new tool allows you to create new resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/1ecea027ceed1aef9bcb5d68361be72443784a7e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/e98ae554c3bbe79082aef2e8d7be8a0a1d4d88b8.gif[/img]

[h3]Enhancers[/h3]
Another type of building we're adding are the Enhancers. They don't do anything when placed, but they'll amplify any future exploitation. Draft wisely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/cd71db16d2d795a83900b6c73aa86e8cfa616d3d.png[/img]

[h3]Versatility[/h3]
Finally, two other small additions to complete your builds. Arsenal is especially good to convert your extra Might at the end of an island!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/35f6476f2ce0f7ceec57885e15e6e2bf16d35a54.png[/img]

[h2]Artifacts[/h2]
This update we took a lot of your ideas and made them into artifacts! Here's a few from the 7 new artifacts that were added :

notes.title: Update 2 : Skaldic Inspiration
notes.content:
[h1]Kare joins the adventure![/h1]
[previewyoutube=RvAdciaG_4w;full][/previewyoutube]
Meet the Skald, a new playable scion expert in card manipulation and adventuring. With every update we try to add a new playstyle into the game. This time, it's all about drawing and upgrading your deck!

[h1]New System : Milestones[/h1]
Kare brings with him a whole new progression & Objectives system. As you play, he will record your adventure and unlock rewards when specific goals have been achieved :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/56816846fab298851046413e97532e317b272748.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] A new page in the Compendium.
[*] Over 50 Milestones
[*] A Progress board for Achievements and Kinships.
[*] A customized challenge called [b]Mastery[/b] for every building card in the game.
[*] Every mastery increases the odds of drafting the associated card upgraded by 1%.
[/list]

[h1]New Content : Cards[/h1]
[h3]New Keyword : [b]Swift[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/417668b306411b952b5bc7b9f1fab25caa60f355.png[/img]

[*] [b]Warehouse[/b] : Gain 40 supplies for each additional Card drawn this turn.
[*] [b]Seer's Guild[/b] : Gain 20 supplies for each Action card in your deck.
[*] [b]Ritual hut[/b] : Gain an Action card draft, gain a Curse card.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/7d3bbda1b8550089c745144a249c67e5e664dc46.png[/img]

A mysterious figure has appeared in Nidavellir! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/0e588eba5aa1fd27f6f3ecdc9a09b890339d3eeb.png[/img]
This new encounter will allow you to obtain a new type of action cards with the [b]Swift[/b] keyword. These are all strong additions to a deck that will give you a lot of flexibility to be more creative in deckbuilding.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/39c00e5c4e2a3be20a589d8182b6203a97f0d10b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/a80451320dec318a378c5f0e53eedd6b3264bead.gif[/img]

[h3]5 New Artifacts[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/56f42b7f1d826bf90eff607b51a4288a903f5e1a.png[/img]

[h1]Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Shattered Shackles[/b] now gives 2 cards instead of 1 when not playing a card during a turn.
[*] [b]Observatory[/b] cost now keep increasing past 100 Eitr. We’ve seen your crazy builds!
[*] Caravan events that can give [b]Acorns[/b] and [b]Blueprints[/b] can now happen only once per map.
[*] Seedlings with area of effect objectives will now have an increased radius when modified by a trial.
[*] [b]Rune Carver[/b] requirements changed to improve flexibility.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/7f97c82ffaba0468c3b3c61372aa6862307411b5.png[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Controls[/h1]
[list]
[*] PController support update :
[list]
[*] Controller support has been greatly expanded! For this update, we mainly focused on controllers that include touchpads, notably Steam Deck, DualSense and DualShock 4 gamepads.
[*] The camera controls have been finetuned for a much snappier experience when navigating with analog sticks.
[*] Common game actions have been mapped to the gamepad, including navigating through your hand, cycling between map objectives, cycling through notifications.
[*] Most in-game popup windows should now react to standard gamepad navigation, without requiring explicit mouse input.

[*] Added AZERTY Keyboard layout support
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/5c95038b4b8257221d58d6a12fc74f1dc9548896.png[/img]
[*] Camera controls are now smoother and snappier.

[h1]Graphics[/h1]
[list]
[*] Notifications now come with a bit of extra flair!
[*] Kare moved in and made the Compendium a little more cozy.
[*] Improved ground “wiggles” quality that give a better hand-drawn look.
[*] Main menu buttons got a small upgrade.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/0fb33ec97ecd6fa18dcded016d496f1556ed7846.gif[/img]
[*] Increased diversity of props in environment
[*] Stairs should now be a lot more visible to help indicate when a path is available.
[*] Changes in the rendering of clouds should make them cleaner.
[*] Updated some icons in the end game screen
[*] Fixed [b]Construct[/b] card having the wrong art in draft screen.
[*] [b]Smite[/b] now feels much better (with sounds too!)
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[h2]Major Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a few Kinships that were unobtainable.
[*] Fixed a possible soft lock in Travel Screen when an event would be cancelled by using the escape key.
[*] Fixed a possible soft lock that happened when skipping some events.
[*] It’s now possible to click through a storm to activate an exploration tile.
[*] Fixed [b]Spade of Vigor[/b] counting all population earned instead of just the current one.
[*] Fixed error in Lif’s Passives calculations which ended up giving twice as much income as it should!
[/list]
[h2]Minor Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Holt Conversations Repeating when restarting the game.
[*] Fixed Draft sometimes giving you the same building twice.
[*] Fixed Instances where notifications of completed events would stay on screen.
[*] Map negative effects are now properly removed at the end of a map even if they have time remaining.
[*] Fixed notifications icons sometimes missing in the Holt when returning from a loop.
[/list]
[h2]Text and Localization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed descriptions of artifacts in compendium sometimes not being accurate.
[*] Fixed headers in settings that were not localized.
[/list]


[h1]That's All[/h1]
It's by far our biggest update so far. Since we added a lot of content, let us know how you feel about the balance on the Steam Forums or on Discord. The next update (Update 3) will focus on adding more content rather than new systems. We're working hard on Update 4 in parallel where we'll tackle another big system : The Holt!

We'll keep you up to date on future updates later, it's time to Reach the top of Yggdrasil with Kare now!

notes.title: Update 1 - Ginnungetgood Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Introduction[/h2]
Our goal in these two weeks after release was to adapt to player feedback and fix as many of the new issues you would discover. This patch contains over [b]100 fixes[/b], ranging from localization issue, misleading tooltips, bugged events to weird item combinations.

We also notice a lot of you found the game too easy. We took that opportunity to prepare an interesting update on the game's difficulty. This time, we've played a lot with the [b]timeline[/b] and the [b]population[/b] mechanics. Let's take a look!

[h2]Update is now live for everyone! - February 8 [/h2]
[strike][h2]Preview Branch[/h2]
The patch will be available on the Preview Branch for now. As we finish the testing properly throughout the week, it will be made available to everyone. If you want to try it out early, here is the process to go on the Preview Branch :
[olist]
[*] Go in the game's properties on Steam.
[*] In the "Betas" tab, enter the code "YggdrasilPreview".
[*] Confirm to switch to the preview Branch!
[/olist][/strike]
[h2]Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Timeline now changes during Night!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/571efd6b0957e23bf5c7980cecb79cc26330758d.gif[/img]
[*] New building : [b]The Drakkar[/b]
[i]It’s time to conquer the seas.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/a1ce42d4c0c7bf698e779322419bf4ad7da9624f.png[/img]
[*] New Trial : [b]Lethargy[/b]
[i]The weight of the world on their shoulders.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/d241ca30882dcc603978a7823dfc398769f948cf.png[/img]
[*] New Artifact : [b]Carved Wood[/b]
[i]The opposite of the Lethargy trial, this new artifact reduce population required to draft by 1. This will be useful when you see the changes on population below![/i]
[/list]
[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*] Artifacts tooltip will now display the cards they mention.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/f10ae25bfd54f110f5cd30631c5bfdfcdd2ebfbd.png[/img]
[*] Negative Events now have a unique look
[*] Notifications have new icons based on their type
[/list]
[h2]UI Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added animations to end of loop panel.
[*] Revamped the Trial of the Gods panel’s UI.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/943983f3c962b9725db4fda954f6d8bc37b6c0e2.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[h3]Population Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Population requirement to draft a new building now increase by 2 every draft.
[/list]
[h3]Drafting Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Common[/b] card chance per level changed from (85%, 75%, 67%, 58%) to (90%, 80%, 75%, 65%)
[*] [b]Uncommon[/b] card chance per level changed from (15%, 20%, 25%, 30%) to (9.5%, 18%, 21%, 27%)
[*] [b]Rare[/b] card chance per level changed from (0%, 5%, 8%, 12%) to (0.5%, 2%, 4%, 8%)
[*] [b]Upgraded[/b] cards can now be drafted. Odds per level (0%, 10%, 20%, 30%)
[/list]
[h3]Timeline Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduce amount of turns per islands before Ginnungagap Spawns
[*] Events are now condensed during day and dusk time.
[/list]
[h3]Card Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Shrub[/b]’s supply per house in range effect decreased from +3/+5 to +2/+3.
[*] [b]Water well[/b]’s suppler per house in range effect decreased from +5/+8 to +3/+5.
[*] Increased [b]Treaded Crane[/b]’s placement requirement from 1 house to 3 houses.
[*] [b]Fishing trap[/b]’s tag changed from Industry to Water
[/list]
[h3]Artifact Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] “[b]World Tree Expert[/b]” changed from +10% bonus income to supply and Eitr per bloomed saplings to +50% Eitr income per bloomed saplings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/250a1483620ba93df77c494c8ae4f5e5bdfbd258.png[/img]
[*] “[b]Sap Stained Goblet[/b]” can now be stacked. Will offer multiple card removal when triggered.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/9a2656c4229650a2d44be2e35753ad0399aa16a6.png[/img]
[/list]
[h3]Level Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Asgard[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 4 Saplings at the entrance to Gimle. The doors of Gimle require at least 2 bloomed saplings.
[*] Removed Gleaming Acorn reward from bridges since there are now saplings on Asgard.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/489d508a8ae4f64790c80d86ebd1a4340a27b60e.png[/img]
[/list][/list]
[h3]Adventure changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Astrolab[/b]
[list]
[*] Astrolab (study the stars event) no longer requires a leader and 6 turns to be completed. It now requires an Eitr source in its range to be activated.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Trial of the Gods changes[/h3]
This first pass on the Trials aims to make them harder, but we have more changes planned soon!
[list]
[*] [b]Ginnungagap’s time pressure[/b] first level reduced from 60 seconds per turn to 45.
[*] [b]Difficult terrain[/b]’s seedbed curses per seedbed increased from +1/+2 to +2/+3.
[*] [b]Supply shortage[/b]’s amount in starting deck increased from 2/4 to 3/5.
[*] [b]Hard to crack[/b]’s objective difficulty increased from 15%/30% to 25%/50%.
[*] [b]Bad draugr[/b]’s AoE increased from +50%/+100% to +100%/+150%.
[/list]
[h3]Scion powers changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Thrasir[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Builder’s boon[/b]’s cooldown reduced from 5 to 4 turns
[/list]
[*] [b]Lif[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Green thumb[/b]’s cooldown increased from 3 to 4 turns
[*] [b]Green thumb[/b]’s amount of trees created reduced from 5/8 to 3/5.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
Most of these fixes were directly reported our community on Discord and on the Steam Forums. Thank you and keep them coming! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/ff45b53a879dc5c01c19b588b4f8ce4bf597fc30.png[/img]

notes.title: Magic viking townbuilder Roots Of Yggdrasil is out in early access
notes.content:
Roots Of Yggdrasil - an inkwashed, roguelikey, card-playing, turn-based citybuilder, inspired by Norse myth - shot to the top of my wishlist after I read Katharine's preview last week. And look, here it is in Early Access. Roots isn't one of your traditional, SimCity-derived town sims in which you steadily colonise a single map (at least, until you lose patience with your glittering urban creation and press the Godzilla or Hurricane button). As per the roguelike element, it's a game about being on the run.

In Roots, you take charge of a band of warriors fleeing an expanding purple smog, the Ginnungagap, in a flying longship. To escape its coils, you must land on floating islands, play cards to raise settlements, and harvest energy for your vessel from the titular roots of the World Tree. Succumb to the advancing mists, and you'll time-rewind back to your Holt to unlock new mechanics and upgrades. There are also various big-league mythological celebrities to meet and recruit, and a variety of randomised encounters and events to shake up each run. Here's the launch trailer.

Instead of building up one metropolis like in Cities Skylines 2, you're stuck in a Norse mythology time loop and need to master the mechanics to find a way out. Plus, there's a drafting and deckbuilding system that persists between runs to help you get further each time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/7f0f4f43464100656858206e667f601ea5cb7f34.png[/img]

notes.title: Dev Blog : Travel Screen
notes.content:
We’ve made a big change last playtest with the implementation of the Deck building mechanics. But for that to work, you need to have the option to make modifications to your deck. That’s exactly what we included in our rework of the level select: the [b]Travel Screen[/b]. 

[h3][b]Travel Screen[/b][/h3]

Each time you complete a map successfully, you will enter the travel screen. This is where you will be able to make choices on how you want to tweak your deck and prepare for the next challenge. Here are some of the events currently available in the Travel Screen:

[list]
[*] Draft new building cards
[*] Choose a building to start with in the next map
[*] Remove cards from your deck
[*] Gain an Artifact
[*] Add a keyword to a building card
[*] Add uses to a building card
[*] Select which biome to go to next
[/list]

Of course, those events are randomized every loop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/aa99e8dcf38c1d69f5d960c10f753a9089b608d0.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Ginnungagap and Time mechanic[/b][/h3]

We’re not going to go too easy on you, all these nice rewards must come at a price. That’s why we’re introducing a time mechanic in the travel screen. You will have to spend some time to move from one event to the other. The further you are from the event you wish to reach, the more time will have to be spent.

Don’t spend too much of it though because the Ginnungagap grows closer with every time spent. Swallowing locations in the travel screen, rendering them unreachable. Moreover, finding yourself in the Ginnungagap’s way will have consequences, such as adding negative modifiers or curse cards into your deck. 

This time currency is also tracked in the maps themselves! Meaning that the shorter time you spend in a level, the more time you will have to discover interest points in the travel screen. Should you hang around the map to draft more cards and explore? Or should you get out quick in the hope to find interesting rewards? That’s for you to decide.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/665737bb296904fa5cde47b49e53972f71a672f8.gif[/img]

[h3][b]More to come[/b][/h3]

Just like the deckbuilding changes, this is still an early implementation of the system, but it has a lot of potential for cool gameplay and narrative options. 

Should we design unique encounters with interesting choices? Creepy characters who can sell and buy Artifacts? The possibilities are endless. It is also a perfect place to learn more about the characters and the lore surrounding the game.

As always, you can sign up for the upcoming playtest that will go live on June 20th and let us know what you think of the changes in our[url=https://discord.gg/AnADj4MJsb] Discord channel[/url]!

See you soon!

notes.title: Dev Blog : Deckbuilding
notes.content:
We constantly want to offer the best experience possible, so we’re not afraid to try new things if we think it will make our games even better. In the upcoming May playtest that’s going live next week, we’re excited to make a big change to the core gameplay with the [b]Deckbuilding[/b] mechanic!

[h3][b]Why deck building?[/b][/h3]

We’ve been thinking about it for a while now. Here are the main problems we’re trying to fix with the deck building mechanics.

[list]
[*] Add replayability.
[*] Make each loop more unique.
[*] Take faster turns.
[*] Make more strategic and meaningful choices.
[*] Add keywords to better communicate what the cards do.
[*] Have more freedom in creation of unique events and buildings.
[*] Rely more on strategy and less on RNG to measure your success.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/d03cf0bc71895f6432346b64e33e6271b63b2719.gif[/img]

[h3][b]How does it work?[/b][/h3]

You will start each loop with a basic set of cards in your draw pile. Each turn, your hand goes in your discard pile, and you draw three new cards from your draw pile. When your draw pile is empty, your discard pile is shuffled and added back into your draw pile!

Reaching a population milestone will reward you with a card draft like it used to, but the card will be added to your draw pile until it is removed. This means that your deck will get bigger with each new draft, it’s up to you to decide how your deck will be constructed!

Cards can now have special keywords in their description, granting them unique behavior. Here are a few examples :

[list]
[*] Cornerstone : Start each map with this card in your hand.
[*] Retain : This card is not discarded when passing the turn.
[*] Exhaust : Remove the card from your deck after it is played, it will rejoin the deck in the next map.
[*] Curse : Card with a negative effect that stays in your deck until you find a way to remove it.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/6bafa142468e349e53d2f9eec50a265b44c5508e.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Future possibilities[/b][/h3]

With the Deck building mechanics, we give you much more control over how your deck is made. We can now add more unique cards, that can be very good depending on what your deck is, and let you discover the synergies between the cards, the Scions and Housing buildings!

It’s a big change, but we believe this opens up a slew of design opportunities, and we’re very excited to create new awesome features with Deck building in mind.

Sign up for the May playtest to test this new version of the game on May 16th and let us know what you think of the changes in our[url=https://discord.gg/AnADj4MJsb] Discord channel[/url]!

Cheers!

notes.title: Dev Blog - Threatening Difficulty
notes.content:
[i][h3]Before we begin, Please note that the Nidavellir Update will be available in April! You can register for the Playtest directly on the Steam Page! [/h3][/i]

As we're moving farther into development and it becomes possible to get closer and closer to the top of Yggdrasil, it's important that the game's difficulty increases as well. We're tackling this task in many ways, but let's explore one way in this post : [b]Threats[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/c90fee1097a6ea2bbd068a9e44cd7c5949fde06f.gif[/img]

[h2]Why did we choose to add threats into the game?[/h2]
Before, a lot of negative effects in the game were simply modifiers that were applied for a certain amount of time. For example, "buildings cost are doubled for 5 turns". This works well to increase difficulty, but it's not very fun and quite easy to forget! 

Here were our goal with the new system :  
[list]
[*] We wanted players to be able to interact with the negative modifiers.
[*] We wanted players to be able to plan around the negative modifiers.
[*] We wanted the negative modifiers to have a physical component.
[/list]

[h2]What are Threats?[/h2]
Threats are dynamic objects that can spawn on the map, applying various effects. Some can be dealt with, others have to be avoided.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/cedf54cccb4f380c8da024c5429868ad76c060b7.png[/img]

[h2]How do Threats appear?[/h2]
Threats can appear in two ways : 
[list]
[*] They can spawn when exploring, making exploration more dangerous!
[*] They can spawn at predetermined turns, as displayed in the timeline.
[/list]

[h2]What do they do?[/h2]
With the new [b]Threat[/b] system, these negative effects are now always linked to something on the map. You might discover a Draugr camp that has a curse that double building costs, but you can now choose to deal with the Draugr quickly to get rid of the effect or maybe even ignore them! That's the case for the Storm, which simply prevents you from building on targeted hexes. It moves every turn, so you can plan around it too!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/a8a720458e1bcea79f7ca44fcb67fcdf54a6b860.png[/img]

[h2]In the Future[/h2]
Threats are very flexible. With the current system, we can have threats with a huge range of effects. It's easy to imagine threats linked to specific biomes as well. Since they're now a proper system, expect other existing systems to play with them as well! Maybe an action card will allow you to get rid of a threat? Maybe a new artefact will reward you with a bonus for every defeated threat? Or maybe even reward you for every ACTIVE threat?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/4df466a02364d19b4c10392860b39dc186d1b5e5.gif[/img]

As always, if you have any comments or ideas about how to use this feature in the future, [url=https://discord.gg/AnADj4MJsb]let us know on Discord[/url]! We're excited to hear what you think! 

[url=https://discord.gg/AnADj4MJsb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/250ec921b6f9622bd6edb8e42ddd01edce16367a.png[/img][/url]

See you soon!

notes.title: An Eitr-esting Change!
notes.content:
Welcome to our dev update! In this post, we’ll talk about the results of our first player survey on the Yggdrasil Discord and the changes that are happening around it. Before we start, make sure you've [url=https://discord.gg/cYwnMqvqaE]joined our discord server[/url] if you want to participate in the next playtest. If you didn’t guess from the terrible pun in the title, the theme of the survery was Eitr and the Star Charts!

[h1]The Eitr Poll Results[/h1]

When we asked about the state of the star charts in the game, the results were pretty clear. Most of you didn’t like how the start charts were in a separate UI, pausing the whole game when opened. On top of that, more than 50% of the players that answered said they often forgot to spend their Eitr! 

The good news is…. That’s pretty much what we expected and we have a plan!

[h1]Lets [i]cut[/i] to the chase[/h1]

In the next playtest, the Star Charts will be gone! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/6d5b611f2d4f7cc758c058c2d3bcfa4086431de9.png[/img]

[h3]What we designed the Star Charts for :[/h3]

- Allow players to react to the randomness by choosing upgrades
- Allow players to make long term choices
- Give another use to Eitr

[h3]Unintended consequences of the Star Charts :[/h3]

- The current design takes the player out of the experience.
- The current design is easily forgettable
- The current design doesn’t have enough meaningful choices

[h2]How we’re fixing it :[/h2]

While the Star Charts are going away for now, everything that was obtainable inside is still present. You’ll now have more opportunities to use Eitr to acquire upgrades and customize your deck in landmarks and buildings that you’ll discover when exploring.

[h2]More Eitr events[/h2]

The Observatory now has a new [b]repeatable[/b] adventure that allows you to draft an Action Card!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/f0816c7c7796133ae1ca73c292197f08ece70399.gif[/img]

New adventures such as the Astrolabe will allow you to draft upgrades and modifiers in exchange for Eitr!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/0dd49d1ab3c85f6a2bd2dbdaeca6a7c8879df68e.gif[/img]

[h2]Eitr… as power![/h2]

We want all resources to be unique, and we felt Eitr still needed an extra change to make it feel different from Supply and Might. Starting next update, Eitr will be used to power up some buildings and for map objectives!

That means you’ll have to build near the Eitr-infused wonders or use pylons to bring that power elsewhere! We hope this brings an extra layer of strategy and variety into the game and we can’t wait for you to start playing with Eitr!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/0844bf770a779d17bb874c1e21dada9d06429baf.gif[/img]

[h1]March playtest and more![/h1]

If you’d like to try out these changes and help us improve the game, [url=https://discord.gg/cYwnMqvqaE]head over to our Discord[/url]! You’ll be able to vote on polls, talk with the devs and soon register for the March Playtest!

notes.title: Building Yggdrasil - 2022 Recap
notes.content:
Hello everyone! For our first update of the year, let's recap what's happened since the last update back in September! Oh, and expect more regular updates from now on too!

[h2]Public Demo[/h2]
The Roots of Yggdrasil team is hard at work preparing a demo that you will soon be able to play! The demo will throw you directly into the action, letting you experience the citybuilding and roguelike elements! And it all starts with the Holt!

[h2]The Holt (Hub)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/2c4c4965189a6722965c92334aed1cad90973592.png[/img]
This is where you'll return after every loop and visit the scions that are helping you on your quest. Each of them has their own stories and ways to help you on your journey. 

Visit Lif at the Greenhouse to gain new permanent abilities! Or visit Thrasir at the Workshop to unlock new buildings for your future expeditions!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/40746392baeb2344f5376752db98abea763099eb.png[/img]

[h2]The Star Charts[/h2]
Another feature that we will preview in the upcoming demo is Star Charts. By spending the Eitr that you gather when creating your villages, you'll be able to research upgrades that will help you in your current run. To embrace the roguelike element, all star charts are procedural, so you'll have to adapt every game![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/0cc84b7020921bac6b4a2c041046f6d5026e56f4.png[/img]

[h2]Biomes[/h2]
The last sneak peek we'll share today are the biomes. We've made a lot of progress and are finally able to showcase the first new biome. Once the beautiful coast of Midgard, these lands are now poisoned by the venom of Jormungandr, the World Serpent, who was slain here by Thor. Now called the Venom Wastes, these hostile lands have become inhospitable. You'll still need to establish settlements here if you wish to power up the portals and keep your journey going!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811555/ba5ff7ecdd48829909650e70c21074ed61354960.png[/img]

[h2]That's it![/h2]
Keep an eye out for more news soon! We can't wait to share the upcoming demo with you!
